Let \(\left( z_{1}, \ z_{2}\right)\) be two complex numbers. Among the following formulas which ones are are not true?
  • . \(\left|{c j n o z_{2}}\right| = - \left|{z_{2}}\right|\)
  • . \(\left|{i z_{2}}\right| = i \left|{z_{2}}\right|\)
  • . \(\left|{\frac{i}{z_{2}}}\right| = \frac{1}{\left|{z_{2}}\right|}\)
  • . \(\left|{\frac{z_{2}}{z_{1}}}\right| = \left|{z_{2}}\right| - \left|{z_{1}}\right|\)
